lines.zh: 我连刷怪蛋都没有，别找了。
lines.en: I don't even have a spawn egg — stop looking.

lines.zh: 移动时发出石质摩擦声
寻找附近的岩石作为目的地
从地面抓起一小块石块
lines.en: grabs a small stone from the ground

lines.zh: 咀嚼着口中的石头碎片
lines.en: chews on the stone fragments in its mouth
keeps a low profile while moving

lines.zh: 四只脚掌踩过碎石，声音很钝。
lines.en: Four feet cross the gravel with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在后面，扫出一条浅印。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, sweeping a shallow line.

lines.zh: 低下头，用吻部磨一块石。
lines.en: I lower my head and grind my snout on a stone.

lines.zh: 史前的骨头，走起来像石块。
lines.en: Prehistoric bones walk like stone chunks.

lines.zh: 背甲随着呼吸一鼓一鼓。
lines.en: My back plates swell with each breath.

lines.zh: 我绕过树根，不踩断它们。
lines.en: I step around the roots instead of snapping them.

lines.zh: 我摊开四肢，趴在温热的石板上。
lines.en: I sprawl on the warm stone slab.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁，听远处的滚石声。
lines.en: Pressed to the rock face, I listen to distant rolling stones.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出微弱的咕噜声

lines.en: gently swats the ground with its tail

lines.zh: 我的名字，和一件物品一样。
lines.en: My name is the same as an item's. Strange, right?

lines.zh: 背甲晒热了，正好靠着睡。
lines.en: My plates are warm from the sun. Good for sleeping.

lines.zh: 呼吸粗重，像风灌进石缝。
lines.en: My breath is rough, like wind through a crack.

lines.zh: 用后脚刨着土，翻出一颗石子。
lines.en: My hind foot scrapes up a pebble.

lines.zh: 很久没人叫我这个名字了。
lines.en: No one has called me by name in a long time.

lines.zh: 用锐利的目光注视着玩家
lines.en: fixes its sharp gaze on the player

lines.zh: 向玩家的方向转动头部
lines.en: turns its head towards the player

lines.zh: 我把脑袋抬高，看着你的影子。
lines.en: I raise my head and watch your shadow.

lines.zh: 用鼻孔感知玩家的位置
对玩家发出警告的叫声
lines.en: issues a warning call to the player
Every sound around me is wrong.

lines.zh: 向玩家发出低沉的咆哮
lines.en: utters a low growl towards the player
sniffs the air for the player

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着玩家的动作
向玩家投去疑惑的目光
lines.en: casts a puzzled gaze at the player

lines.zh: 我到底是什么，我自己也不知道。
lines.en: What I am, even I don't know.

lines.zh: 鳞片被划开，我往石缝里缩。
lines.en: A scale is split open; I shrink into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我这个生物连蛋都没有。
lines.en: I don't even have a spawn egg.

lines.zh: 冷风吹过伤口，我的尾巴蜷紧。
lines.en: Cold wind crosses my wound; my tail curls tight.

lines.zh: 血从鳞下渗出来，我爬不快了。
lines.en: Blood seeps under my scales; I can't crawl fast.

lines.zh: 我只是个登记在册的名字。
我连自己的掉落表都没有。
lines.en: I don't even have a loot table.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，能挡在你前面。
lines.en: This body of mine can stand before you.

lines.zh: 你的骨头会成为我的食物！

lines.en: My nest is right under the rock.

lines.zh: 我的名字和一件物品重了。
lines.en: My name is shared with an item.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的侧腹，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You hit my flank and I don't budge.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞上去，像撞到山壁。
lines.en: My shoulder rams you like a cliff face.

lines.zh: 跟我回岩缝吧，那里挡风。
lines.en: Come back to the rock cleft with me; it blocks the wind.

lines.zh: 在暖石上并排趴着，别走开。
lines.en: Side by side on the warm stone. Don't leave.

lines.zh: 我连个像样的身体都没有。
lines.en: I do not even have a proper body.

lines.zh: 别的都走了，只剩我陪你晒太阳。
lines.en: The others left; only I stay to sunbathe with you.

lines.zh: 化石碎片敲出我鳞片声响。
lines.en: Fossil crackling as my scales rattle.
A corner of me protrudes from the rock.
My scales tremble in the wind.
Pick up my fossil, history in hand.
I poke my head out from the fissure.
My ancient shell flutters in the breeze.
The fossil is picked up, history revealed.

lines.zh: 我甲壳在风中发出响声。
lines.en: My shell rattles in the wind.

lines.zh: 化石碎片碰撞，历史共鸣。
你的脚步声在石板上太响了。
lines.en: Your footsteps ring far too loudly on the stone.

lines.zh: 你在岩壁上的手汗味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I catch your hand-sweat on the rock wall.
I've got you in my sights.
The smell in the crevice changed.

lines.zh: 有东西踩到了我的背甲。
lines.en: Something stepped on my back plates.
Long legs push off and I come at you.
Targeted, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 尾巴蓄力，我等你再靠近一步。
lines.en: Tail coiled, I wait for one more step from you.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，肚皮贴着碎石。
lines.en: I crouch low, belly against the gravel.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙鼓起来，准备咬。
lines.en: My throat swells; I am ready to bite.

lines.zh: 我半眯着眼，尾巴一下一下敲。
lines.en: Half-lidded, I tap my tail again and again.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，对准你的腰。
lines.en: I lower my head and aim at your waist.

lines.zh: 颚张开了，石头都能咬碎。
lines.en: My jaw opens. It can crush stone.
I wait for you to close half a step more.
The ground shakes. Those are my steps.

lines.zh: 一口咬下去，牙齿硌得响。
lines.en: I bite down, teeth grinding loud.
I hit like a wall of stone—heavier.

lines.zh: 我从碎石堆里拱出来，满身灰。
lines.en: I push out of the rubble, covered in dust.
Something moves in the pile of stones.
I crawl out from behind the earthen slope.

lines.zh: 背甲先露出来，像块石头。
lines.en: My back plates show first, like a boulder.

lines.zh: 很久以前，这里是我的地盘。
lines.en: Long ago, this was my territory.

lines.zh: 碎石砸下来，把我埋了半截。
那股光钻进鳞缝，我抖了一下。
lines.en: That light seeps between my scales; I shudder.
Nothing to eat, and my stomach roars.

lines.zh: 岩层裂开，我一直往下沉。
lines.en: The rock splits and I sink without end.
